Title: General availability: Data flows in Azure Data Factory and Azure Synapse now support Reserved Instances

Body.Content:
As you build more and more extensive and complicated ETL (extract, transform, load) pipelines in ADF and Synapse using Data Flows, you can now set hourly reservations using Reserved Instance pricing options for Data Flows. In the Azure portal, choose Reservations and under Azure Data Factory, you will be able select your types of Data Flows to reserve: Memory Optimized or General Purpose.

Learn more.
